segments.speaker: rep
segments.text: thanks for jumping on tom i know things have been busy since we last spoke in june

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: they had and i should be straight with you not much has moved on our side

segments.speaker: rep
segments.text: that is fair when we last talked the driver was ramping the new reps faster is that still a priority

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: it is still a problem but it is not the priority anymore we paused hiring in august so we are not ramping anybody right now

segments.speaker: rep
segments.text: understood is there a point in the year where that changes

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: maybe january depending on how the quarter lands i genuinely do not know and i do not want to give you a date that is not real

segments.speaker: rep
segments.text: i appreciate that is there anyone else internally for whom this is live right now even if it is not you

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: not really our enablement lead left in july and nobody has picked that up so there is no one championing it

segments.speaker: rep
segments.text: then i do not think there is a deal here this quarter and i would rather say that than keep booking calls

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: i respect that check back with me in january and if hiring restarts i will tell you honestly
